title: ARIA AZT Stops the Black October AI Attacks - Without the Need for Patches.
summary: Unknown CVEs hit 4,000 a week in October as AI sped up exploits. Learn how ARIA AZT protects apps and out-of-support endpoints with no patch needed.
body_markdown:
The industry is under a deluge of unknown CVEs being exposed and exploited by AI at rates that have made patching ineffective. October hit a peak rate 4000 per week. 10x higher than the previous year.


Vendors can’t provide patches fast enough and AI attackers are proving they can get through your network defenses unless you are perfectly protected every moment of each day. And yet, AI is finding an unprecedented set of


vulnerabilities in firewall and network security systems as well.


Today’s Leading Next Gen AV vendors offer little help from these new forms of attacks, as Crowdstrike CEO told Jim Cramer. “We can buy you time, but you must patch…and you can’t patch legacy devices”.


This means everything the “industry counted on” for security - suddenly is unreliable.


Fortunately, ARIA has had a solution on the market for 4 years that stops these AI attacks.


ARIA AZT PROTECT™ is 99% effective in stopping the AI assaults on critical applications and the OS’s they run on during the month of October.


**This includes the PHP2SHELL Attacks** that Crowdstrike, and others do not claim to stop on legacy systems.


What’s more, it successfully protects legacy out of support end points with the same efficacy.


ARIA AZT as a compensating control, is savings our customers $10s of millions by extending their devices useful life.


As proof - see our series of blogs, including this[blog that shows how we stop the Black October and other AI assults](https://blog.ariacybersecurity.com/blog/how-azt-stops-the-black-october-php2shell-attack) .
